title: What If You Had 9 Brains Like an Octopus?
description:
What if your arms could think for themselves? An octopus has around 500 million nerve cells, and about two thirds of them are in its arms. Its arms can taste what they touch, act on their own, and even keep grabbing after they've been separated. Here's what life would be like with octopus arms... and why you already have a second brain inside you.

Would you want octopus arms, or would tasting every doorknob be too much? Tell me in the comments 👇
